_comment: Boilerplate/template for the deck delivery JSON contract. JSON has no real comment syntax, so every field's placeholder VALUE describes what belongs there and its type. Delete this _comment key in real output. Fields split into two groups: user-defined scope (input, confirmed with the user before building) and actual output (populated by the MCP tools after building).

userDefinedScope.deckDesignPreference: <string: user's general description of what they want, e.g. 'aggressive go-wide tokens deck'>
userDefinedScope.priceLimitUsd: <number OR null: user's price ceiling. null means no price constraint -- NOT a 'cheap decks only' tool, see build_deck_by_price>
userDefinedScope.bracketLevel: <string OR null: user's requested Commander bracket, e.g. 'Bracket 3'. NOTE: not currently enforced during build -- bracket is computed AFTER the deck is built (see actualOutput.bracket), not built toward. If bracketLevel is set and the actual bracket doesn't match, flag that mismatch to the user rather than silently ignoring it.>
userDefinedScope.userColorPreference: <array of strings OR null: e.g. ['W','B'], or null if the user has no preference and Claude should decide based on the commander/theme>
userDefinedScope.userCommanderPreference: <string OR null: exact commander name if the user wants a specific one, or null if Claude should pick one that fits deckDesignPreference>

actualOutput.commander: <string: exact name of the commander actually used>
actualOutput.priceUsd: <number: actual total deck price from get_deck_price_total (Card Kingdom)>

combos.pieces: <array of strings: card names making up this combo>

actualOutput.strategy: <string: general_strategy -- how to actually pilot the deck turn to turn>
wincons: <string: one win condition, repeat as needed>

fullDeckList.name: <string: card name>
fullDeckList.imageUrl: <string OR null: Scryfall's small image_uris URL (from consistency.js's card_details map), a plain https:// URL -- deliberately NOT base64-inlined. Embedding ~100 cards' worth of images blows the MCP tool response well past its ~1MB cap; report_path's saved local file is where images actually load reliably (a real browser has no CSP restriction on a file:// page). scryfall/images.js's inlineCardImages exists for the separate case of manually re-embedding images before publishing this HTML as a shareable web Artifact, which DOES block external image hosts by CSP -- not used by default here>
fullDeckList.typeLine: <string: full type line as Scryfall returns it>
fullDeckList.oracleText: <string: full rules text, from consistency.js's card_details map>

actualOutput.moxfieldImport: <string: plain-text decklist in Moxfield's import format ('1 Card Name' per line) -- this is just decklist_text, Moxfield import has no separate object format>
actualOutput.numberOfManaRocks: <number: HEURISTIC -- inferred from artifact + oracle text matching '{T}: Add', not a real Scryfall field, will have edge-case misses>
actualOutput.cardDrawCount: <number: HEURISTIC -- oracle text keyword match on 'draw a card' etc, approximate, will misclassify some conditional/rare draw effects>
actualOutput.removalCount: <number: HEURISTIC -- oracle text keyword match on 'destroy target'/'exile target'/damage-based removal etc, approximate>
actualOutput.manaCurve: <object OR null: nonland card count by CMC bucket, keys '0'-'6' and '7+', from analyze_deck_consistency's mana_curve>
actualOutput.curveOutProbability: <object OR null: analyze_deck_consistency's curve_out_probability verbatim -- a 'note' string plus turn_1..turn_6 fields, each the probability (0-1) of having drawn at least that many lands by that turn (7-card opening hand + 1 draw/turn). SIMPLIFIED model -- no mulligans/scry/ramp/card-draw spells factored in>
consistencyIssues: <string: one issue from analyze_deck_consistency's issues array, empty array if the deck is clean>
actualOutput.bracketLevelMatchesRequest: <boolean OR null: null if userDefinedScope.bracketLevel wasn't set; otherwise whether actualOutput.bracket matches what the user asked for>
actualOutput.otherRelevantInfo: <string OR null: anything else worth flagging -- e.g. notable card substitutions, budget cards used in place of an expensive staple, etc.>
